items.h: Fantasy football free agent pickups: C.J. Stroud, Kendre Miller lead top options
items.s: Eric Karabell lists who he thinks are the top available players worth adding for the week ahead.

items.h: Johnson won't return to Thursday's game in Detroit due to a concussion.
items.s: Late in the first half, Johnson was checked for a head injury, which now has been confirmed. He'll finish Week 13 action without a touch after recording a touchdown in back-to-back outings prior to Thursday's contest.
